build_llava_next_model: build an LLaVA-NeXT multimodal model for conditional text generation with vision inputs
create_processing_info: create LLaVA-NeXT processing info to compute image token counts from image dimensions
test_image_merge: test the _merge_image_patch_embeddings method for combining vision patch embeddings spatially
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on LLaVA-NeXT with image inputs and token positions to produce hidden states
review_load_weights: review the load_weights method that maps HuggingFace checkpoint weights to vLLM model weights
